note: M59 (#825) row identity for clojure: every call edge carries the callee's 1-based line, so two call SITES of one callee are two rows (pre-fix: 0/8381 corpus edges lined, all sites of a callee collapsed into one). The null-line forbid pins the collapse defect: a regression that drops the line emits an unlined pick edge, which no expect entry can express absent. Arity rides the identity too (ER-D2 parity): `(pick)` vs `(pick 1)` are distinct edges, meta.callArity states each.
